name: slot-coupon
title: Slot coupon
orientation: Loose pieces flat on the bed as drawn: tongues head down, carriers floor down, printed slots standing on end with their floor down
description: For slot 6 (20 mm beams) and slot 8 (30 and 40 mm beams): five tongues and five printed nut carriers (M2.5 in slot 6, M5 in slot 8) at clearances either side of the printer's fit, and three short printed slots for a bought slot nut. Each piece carries its clearance a side, the figure to write back with cad measured (MEASURE.md, rows 29 to 33). Drawn from the slot's rule set: print it again once the slot is measured.

base.rule: A tongue's head and a printed slot's floor: six layers, and a first layer that is one plain piece

wall.rule: Plastic round a printed slot, and a tongue's head beyond the opening each side: four print lines

gap.rule: Between pieces, between a feature and its figure, and round the edge

root.rule: The V-groove each side of a tongue's root, so the tongue meets its head with no square inside corner and the head still lies flat on the beam's face

fit.rule: The middle clearance a side: what the kit draws a printed part in a slot with until the slot fit is measured

step.rule: Tongues and carriers step by half the printer's hole compensation: a printed width comes out about that far either way, and a slot's opening is held to a tenth or two

slot_step.rule: Printed slots step by the printer's hole compensation, the amount a printed hole comes out wrong by

fits.rule: Five tongues and five carriers: the printer's fit and two steps either side

slots.rule: Three printed slots: the printer's fit and a step either side

key.rule: A tongue's length along the slot: longer than the opening is wide, so it slides straight and cannot twist

tall.rule: A printed slot's height: longer than a bought slide-in nut, so it slides its whole length

label.rule: Figure height: six print lines tall, readable close up, and narrow enough to sit across a carrier's top

stroke.rule: One print line, for the figures

segments.rule: Facets on the rounds of a printed slot's corners
